popCulture.title: Leucothea
popCulture.description: Ino's afterlife is the white sea-goddess Leucothea — the Theban queen who leaps with Melicertes and rises to save drowning Odysseus.

popCulture.title: Ino (Greek mythology)
popCulture.description: Ino remains Cadmus' daughter who nursed Dionysus and fled Athamas' madness — stepmother, victim, and finally a goddess of the surf.
